{{Top|leg}}
A '''smelting ship''' was an immense [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used to pulverize [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], collect the debris, then extract useful and valuable minerals from the remains. [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]] operated a number of these vessels throughout the [[Mestra system/Legends|Mestra system]].
